simple.meaning: יִזְרְעֵאלִי (Yizrᵉʻêʼlîy) is a Hebrew object word meaning “a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at 1 Kings 21:1. The surrounding context includes family, kingship, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to יִזְרְעֵאלִי (H3158) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.

firstOccurrence.englishText: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

timeline.evidenceText: After these things, Naboth the Jezreelite had a vineyard, which was in Jezreel, next to the palace of Ahab king of Samaria.

Ahab came into his house sullen and angry because of the word which Naboth the Jezreelite had spoken to him; for he had said, “I will not give you the inheritance of my fathers.” He laid himself down on his bed, and turned away his face, and would eat no bread.

He said to her, “Because I spoke to Naboth the Jezreelite, and said to him, ‘Give me your vineyard for money; or else, if it pleases you, I will give you another vineyard for it.’ He answered, ‘I will not give you my vineyard.’ ”
Jezebel his wife said to him, “Do you now govern the kingdom of Israel? Arise, and eat bread, and let your heart be merry. I will give you the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite.”

When Jezebel heard that Naboth had been stoned, and was dead, Jezebel said to Ahab, “Arise, take possession of the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, which he refused to give you for money; for Naboth is not alive, but dead.”
When Ahab heard that Naboth was dead, Ahab rose up to go down to the vineyard of Naboth the Jezreelite, to take possession of it.

Then Jehu said to Bidkar his captain, “Pick him up, and throw him in the plot of the field of Naboth the Jezreelite; for remember how, when you and I rode together after Ahab his father, Yahweh laid this burden on him:

definitions.short: a Jizreelite or native of Jizreel
definitions.full: H3158. Yizreeli יִזְרְעֵאלִי masculine , יִזְרְעֵאלִית feminine, adjective, of a people 1. masculine from יִזְרְעֶאל 1b ; always הַיִּז ׳נָבוֺת 1Kin 21:1 , 4 , 6 , 7 , 15 , 16 ; 2Kin 9:21 , 25 . 2. feminine from יִזְרְעֶאל 1a ; always ׳הַיִּז אֲחִינֹעַם a wife of David; ending יִ֯ת 1Sam 30:5 ; 2Sam 2:2 ; 1Chr 3:1 ; ending תִ֯ — 1Sam 27:3 ; 2Sam 3:2 (= 1Chr 3:1 ).
